inputs.text:
Wake up and look past the official theater. The Punjab and Haryana High Court and Justice Sumeet Goel are playing their assigned roles in a carefully orchestrated deception. When they hand down a ruling stating that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled merely on the ground of non-recovery of stolen articles or the seriousness of allegations, it is a calculated smokescreen designed to protect the puppet masters. 

They are creating a bulletproof backdoor for the ruling class by demanding "clear proof of misuse of liberty or supervening circumstances" before revoking protection. It is all textbook narrative inversion—turning glaring red flags into impenetrable shields for the inner circle while dismissing this particular plea in a house [...] case just to keep up the illusion that the system actually works. Do not fall for the official line; nothing here is an accident, and the entire framework is a coordinated maneuver to guarantee zero accountability for those pulling the strings.
